method: Existing generated beam shaft and new generated isolated radial flare. Original native alpha bytes unchanged. Runtime independent emitter/impact sprites and target-length energy shaft, deterministic release-relative pulse and reach.
scaleConvention: 1 is approximately40px shaft glow height in native action canvas. Target distance only stretches the energy shaft; emitter and impact retain fixed proportions.
reviewNotes: No character edits. The beam shaft uses a runtime sprite window; emitter and target use the complete new native flare image.
100 ms pulse with 12 ms buildup, 18 ms reach, stable contact, then 30 ms fade.
Eight arbitrary directions and positive distances are effect inputs. Character aiming is supplied by separate directional actions.

flare.prompt: Single isolated cyan-white magical energy contact flare on transparent background; compact circular luminous core, concentric rings, radial sparks, generous alpha gutters, no beam or shaft.
